title: P1: Outpost bed captures home seeds through a symlink
detail: At pinned head 5ec9f5d43de6c60b63d8df1960ad39f2adb9d386, bind an outpost Shop checkout by its absolute path and a home Billing repository by name. If the same path on home is a symlink to Billing, a newly planted home Billing seed is stored under Shop. Both home plants went to Billing on the parent routing implementation. A real CLI against an isolated wire world and a fresh independent reviewer reproduced the result; the outpost bridge was simulated. Evidence: s-6ghb7w/garden-bed-routing-review-ce7a3ec.md and garden-bed-routing-evidence-ce7a3ec.tar.gz.
